description: Connect an integration from list_integrations to your trial tenant. For API-key providers, pass api_key and any required config fields and it connects immediately (Cal.com needs list_calcom_event_types called first for event_type_id — every other provider's config fields are typed directly from that provider's own dashboard). For OAuth providers (Shopify, HubSpot, Google Calendar, Square, ...), returns a connect_url a human must open and approve — it can't be completed headlessly. Requires the secret_key from create_trial_tenant, either as the secret_key argument or an "Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>" header.

api_key.description: The provider's API key/token, for API-key-based providers.

config.description: Provider-specific config fields (see the provider's configFields — e.g. Cal.com needs event_type_id).

provider.description: The integration name from list_integrations, e.g. "calcom".

secret_key.description: The secret_key returned by create_trial_tenant, if your client can't send it as an "Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>" header instead.

name: configure_integration
title: Configure Integration
